speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) seeks to secure sustained non-inflationary economic growth, a robust and resilient financial sector, and Singapore’s position as a leading international financial centre in Asia.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Downside risks to global growth have increased, even as continuing labour market pressures keep inflation elevated.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Inflation is expected to moderate during the year but will remain higher than the historical norm.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS has steadily tightened monetary policy since October 2021.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: This has helped to dampen inflation and anchor inflation expectations.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will continue to focus on ensuring medium-term price stability as the basis for sustained economic growth.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Amid volatile international financial markets and stresses in global banking, MAS will seek to safeguard the safety and resilience of Singapore’s financial sector.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Through regular risk assessments and close supervisory monitoring, MAS ensures that banks in Singapore are well-capitalised, keep healthy liquidity positions, and are underpinned by a stable and diversified funding base.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: In addition, MAS reviews banks’ regular internal stress tests against interest rate, credit and other risks.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS also conducts an annual industry-wide stress test of key financial institutions in Singapore.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS stands ready to provide liquidity through a range of facilities to ensure that Singapore’s financial system remains stable and financial markets continue to function in an orderly manner at times of global stress.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS has partnered the financial industry to develop the Industry Transformation Map (ITM) 2025.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: It sets out five key growth strategies for the financial sector for 2021 to 2025: enhance asset class strengths, digitalise financial infrastructure, catalyse Asia’s net-zero transition, shape the future of financial networks, and foster a skilled and adaptable workforce.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: The financial sector is on track to achieving these targets, growing by an average 4.8% per year and adding an average 7,300 jobs per year during 2021 to 2022.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will catalyse insurance risk advisory and alternative risk transfer solutions for Asia.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will position Singapore as Asia’s centre for philanthropy by building philanthropy advisory competencies and solutions.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will develop private credit to complement private equity and venture capital funding.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will anchor promising FinTech start-ups in Web 3.0, artificial intelligence, and green FinTech.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will also continue to work with the financial industry to broaden and deepen the electronic foreign exchange trading ecosystem in Singapore.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will help develop an ecosystem of stakeholders to mobilise capital and support Asia’s transition to a net-zero emissions future.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will develop clear taxonomy criteria to identify green and transition activities for eight key sectors in 2023.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will promote the scaling up of blended and transition finance, to facilitate the decarbonisation of key sectors of the economy.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will also enhance sustainability disclosures and develop data utilities which will facilitate corporate disclosures and investors’ access to companies’ Environmental, Social, and Governance data.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: From the angle of financial stability, MAS will also work with the industry to enhance its resilience to the risks posed by climate change.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Together with industry partners, MAS will accelerate efforts to develop new digital infrastructure and platforms to enhance industry efficiency, access new markets, and promote new models in digital finance.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: In bond markets, we will develop infrastructure to facilitate more seamless end-to-end issuance, listing and settlement for Asian securities transactions.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: In the funds industry, we will work with industry participants to pilot digital utilities to reduce settlement time, enhance the efficiency and transparency of post-trade funds settlement for fund managers.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will continue to enhance cross-border payment connectivity with key partner jurisdictions.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We have established bilateral real-time cross-border payment linkages with Thailand and India, and are currently working with Malaysia on a similar linkage.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS is also working with the Bank for International Settlements Innovation Hub on a multilateral solution to link fast payment systems within ASEAN.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Through these linkages, users in Singapore and our partner jurisdictions are now able to transfer funds directly to one another’s bank accounts or e-wallets almost instantly using a mobile number or Quick Response code.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Together with the industry, MAS will help evolve an innovative and responsible digital asset ecosystem.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We are exploring the potential of distributed ledger technology in promising use cases, particularly in cross-border payment and settlement, trade finance, and pre- and post-trade capital market activities.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We are also working with the industry to explore the potential of tokenisation of financial and real economy assets.
